data.name: Kethavath
data.gender_notes: Kethavath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Kethavath is the name of Lord Vishnu in his form as the preserver of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kethu' meaning 'fortune' and 'Vath' meaning 'lord'. Kethavath is believed to bestow good fortune, prosperity, and protection upon his devotees. The name Kethavath carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kethavath usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the divine to bless and protect.
data.etymology: Kethavath belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kethavath total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Kethavath is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture. It is a revered name in Indian communities, particularly among those who follow Hinduism. The significant spiritual part of this name echoes the importance of Lord Vishnu in Hinduism. Kethavath highlights the belief in the power of the deities to influence one's life, bringing fortune and prosperity to those who seek their guidance and protection. This name also showcases the rich cultural heritage and deep spiritual connection that the Hindu community maintains.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Kethavath symbolizes the divine power of Lord Vishnu and the belief that he grants good fortune, prosperity, and protection. The name carries a profound sense of hope, as those who invoke Kethavath believe that they are in the care of the deity and that he will help them overcome challenges and bring positive change to their lives. This spiritual significance is an essential part of Hindu spirituality, as it emphasizes the importance of faith, devotion, and the belief in the power of the deities to guide and protect their followers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kethavath in Hinduism symbolizes the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ketu' (a planet symbolizing knowledge) and 'Vath' (air, symbolizing the swift dissemination of knowledge). Thus, Kethavath represents the individual who not only possesses deep wisdom but also shares it freely with others.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Kethavath was a Chola king who ruled from Uraiyur in the late 10th century AD The name Kethavath carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kethavath remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
